value: Use goroutines + channels for concurrency. Prefer sync.WaitGroup for fan-out. Use context for cancellation and timeouts. Avoid shared mutable state — communicate via channels.
Always check errors. Wrap with fmt.Errorf('%w', err) to preserve chain. Use errors.Is/As for comparison. Never ignore errors from deferred Close().
Use type hints everywhere. Prefer dataclasses or Pydantic for structured data. Virtual envs mandatory. Use pathlib not os.path. Prefer f-strings over .format().
Prefer const over let. Use discriminated unions for state machines. Avoid any — use unknown and narrow. Zod for runtime validation. Async/await over raw Promises.
RESTful: nouns not verbs. HTTP verbs semantically (GET idempotent, POST creates). Version in URL (/v1/). Return 4xx for client errors, 5xx for server. Always include error message in body.

Test behaviour not implementation. AAA pattern: Arrange, Act, Assert. Unit tests under 1ms. Integration tests isolated with testcontainers. Coverage > 80% on core paths. Mutation testing for critical logic.
Never log secrets. Parameterise SQL queries. Hash passwords with bcrypt/argon2. Validate all inputs server-side. Set Content-Security-Policy. Use HTTPS everywhere. Principle of least privilege.
Measure first (pprof, flamegraph). Optimise hot paths only. Prefer data locality. Batch DB calls. Cache at the right layer. Avoid premature optimisation — clean correct code first.
Multi-stage builds to minimise image size. Run as non-root user. Pin base image tags. Use .dockerignore. Health checks mandatory. Never store secrets in ENV — use secrets management.
Requests and limits on every pod. Readiness probe required. PodDisruptionBudget for HA. HPA for autoscaling. Network policies to restrict egress. Use namespaces for environment isolation.
Fast feedback (< 10 min build). Trunk-based development. Feature flags over long-lived branches. Deploy to prod via pipeline only. Automated rollback on health-check failure. Shift security left.
Three pillars: Metrics (Prometheus), Logs (structured JSON → Loki/ELK), Traces (OpenTelemetry). Alert on user-facing symptoms (latency/error rate), not causes. SLOs drive alerting thresholds.
